T-3175: 1827 Prairie's pavilion carried up an attic under a steep hipped crown and finial (#1352)

The pavilion rises through the mansard from the main eave (12.6 m) to its
own cornice at the main curb's height (16.8 m), three tall lights in its
attic wall, under K05's hipped crown at 47 degrees to a point (~20.5 m)
with a turned iron finial. The kit gains an optional crown finial (the
deck's turning, T-3000) and an attic up to 4.5 m (1827's is the whole
mansard storey). The pavilion's own roof goes flat inside the crown, as at
1815. 42 K01/K12/K13/K16 masters re-emitted byte-identical for the moved
generator hash. Match record and LIBERTIES updated; the corner tower is
T-3176 (the 1911 sheet's bump and the photograph disagree ~2x on its face).

Co-authored-by: polecat-steward <steward@polecat.live>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
